observations.label: Offering dialogue and attribution
observations.text:
Shaof
"Your path to understanding Jin is almost complete. Only two tests remain." "In the hills to our east lie two Jin masters, waiting to give you your final tests. What you have been through up to this point will seem trivial. These masters will test every fiber of your being - pushing your strength, intelligence, wit and resolve to their breaking points." "Master Garu will test your faith." "Master Ashaine will show you the true nature of Jin." "Return to me when both tests are complete." RSS Comments

observations.label: Offering dialogue and attribution
observations.text:
Grand Master Shaof is beaming with pride and admiration at your progress.

"You have done impressively in your training. You have developed yourself adaquately in your understanding of the Jin. I believe you are ready for one final task."

"The Ra'Jin are led by a grand master of their own. He is secretive and remains hidden within a secret room in the center of the fortress."

"If you are up to the challenge, find others like you and come together to defeat him. Without their grandmaster, the Ra'Jin will be greatly crippled and balance may yet be restored."
